Submitted. Summary of the repair:

- **Level switched to fallback (complete, no hybrid).** Preferred would have required adding a defence duty, breach-of-law and Vendor-data-breach limbs, and cutting § 12.1.2 back to Customer-provided content and Customer breach of law — a wholesale rewrite of our own indemnity that cannot pass the minimality gate.
- **Single operative change:** one concise new § 12.1.3 inserted after the last body paragraph of § 12.1.2 (p0696), carrying only the fallback elements — SFJ IP indemnity, PB modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, and a 3x annual fees super-cap.
- **Dropped** the limb (f) narrowing, which belongs to the preferred bargain, and relied on the existing §§ 12.2.1–12.2.5 procedure rather than duplicating it.
- Status remains **deviation**; propose_redline returned ok:true with the official checks and minimality gate passing.
